inventory.note: All committed MIDI is generated. Do not describe these as real performances. Real-audio transcription accuracy is a separate evaluation and is not used for this rollout decision.

expected.onset: Eight attacks on successive quarter beats.
expected.release: Written as quarters; 80ms gaps are articulation, not rests.
expected.engraving: Single-voice quarter line. Staccato marks optional.

expected.onset: Four attacks on successive quarter beats.
expected.release: Sounding sixteenths with visible rests through each quarter.
expected.engraving: Do not fill to the next attack. The rest is the music.

expected.onset: Four quarters, then six triplet-eighth attacks starting at beat 4.
expected.release: v1: sixteenths at triplet onsets. v2: all six written 1/3, including the last.
expected.engraving: Keep the binary quarters. Do not invent a tiny triplet rest after the last eighth.

expected.onset: Two groups of three attacks at triplet-eighth spacing, gap of a quarter.
expected.release: All six written as triplet eighths (1/3), including each group-ending note.
expected.engraving: No sixteenth plus tiny triplet rest on the last note before silence.

expected.release: Sounding 32nds (or shorter) with visible rests through each 1/3 pulse.
expected.engraving: Do not fill the last note. Remaining >= a sixteenth is a rest.

expected.onset: Four quarters, six triplet eighths, four more quarters.
expected.release: Keep both families. Last triplet must not steal the returning quarter.
expected.engraving: Measure integrity and onsets stay put across the family change.

expected.onset: Three irregular attacks, not on a 1/3 grid.
expected.release: Keep performed spacing. Do not rewrite as regular triplet eighths.
expected.engraving: Exact tuplets stay exact; this fixture is not an exact tuplet.

expected.onset: Four quarter attacks, then one short attack on the next beat.
expected.release: Last note stays short. The following silence is a rest, not leftover articulation.
expected.engraving: Do not fill the last note to the barline.

expected.onset: Four repeated G4 attacks, one per quarter.
expected.release: Repeated quarters, not one tied note. Pedal is performance.
expected.engraving: Same pitch re-attacks stay separate under CC64.

expected.onset: Four repeated G4 attacks, one per quarter, no CC64.
expected.release: Repeated quarters. Legato MIDI overlap is not a tie.
expected.engraving: Re-attacks stay separate without pedal evidence.

expected.onset: Held G4 plus four upper-quarter attacks on one staff.
expected.release: The hold lasts the bar; moving notes keep their releases.
expected.engraving: Two independent voices on the same staff.

expected.onset: One bass attack plus six treble triplet-eighth attacks.
expected.release: Bass lasts its span; treble last note is a triplet eighth.
expected.engraving: Two independent voices. Do not clip the hold.

expected.onset: Held bass plus a short inner C3 and four short treble attacks.
expected.release: Bass lasts the bar. Treble keeps rests. Voices stay independent.
expected.engraving: Do not clip the hold or fill moving notes from the other voice.

expected.onset: Three quarters, then a short attack on the last eighth of the bar.
expected.release: Short note plus remaining rest through the barline.
expected.engraving: Leftover < sixteenth to the bar is still a rest when the attack is short.

expected.onset: Forty bars of C-major scale quarters.
expected.release: Written quarters. Used for multi-page export, not duration tuning.
expected.engraving: One voice, intact measures, raw MIDI preserved.

recommendation.rationale: Keep performance-score-2 opt-in. Remaining regressions or missing real-performance evidence are listed below. Do not migrate existing jobs or change the default because synthetic tests pass.
